attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Virginia military retirement exemption calculation. VA allows $40,000 exemption on military retirement pay (2025). Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize VA military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "VA Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.va_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.va_military_retirement_exemption get min /va_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get va_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.va_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"VA military retirement exemption applied: $" va_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.va_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exemption
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.va_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No VA military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Virginia state income tax calculation. Implements progressive 4-bracket tax structure per VA tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Virginia Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.va_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /va_agi xdef
va_agi result.va_standard_deduction_joint get sub 0 max /va_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /va_tax xdef
va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_1_limit get min 0 max result.va_bracket_1_rate get mul /va_tax xdef
va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_1_limit get gt if va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_2_limit get min result.va_bracket_1_limit get sub 0 max result.va_bracket_2_rate get mul va_tax add /va_tax xdef then
va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_2_limit get gt if va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_3_limit get min result.va_bracket_2_limit get sub 0 max result.va_bracket_3_rate get mul va_tax add /va_tax xdef then
va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_3_limit get gt if va_taxable_income result.va_bracket_3_limit get sub 0 max result.va_bracket_4_rate get mul va_tax add /va_tax xdef then
va_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Virginia tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat " (Taxable income: $" strconcat va_taxable_income cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
